title: Loading, error, success: model all three
why_it_matters: Every screen with data needs these three states.
explanation: Every request has three moments: waiting, success and failure. Model them with a status value, and your UI always has something honest to show: a spinner, the data, or a retry message. Skipping this makes screens flash empty or freeze.
try_it: Sketch what your UI shows in each of the three states.
